title: Cursor in Slack Improvements and Side Chats - July 17, 2026
description: Cursor in Slack now shares a plan before starting, runs in multi-repo environments, and can work across channels and threads. Added side chats for parallel conversations, conversation search with local indexing, and redesigned project/repo pickers. New cloud agent hooks, Team MCPs in marketplaces, and Cursor Mobile App for iOS in public beta.

title: Repository-level GitHub Copilot Usage Metrics - July 17, 2026
description: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics became generally available. The GitHub Copilot app is now available in the usage metrics API.

title: Copilot Code Review Customization - July 17, 2026
description: Improvements to Copilot code review customization and configurability.

title: GitHub Mobile: Fix PR Comments with Copilot - July 17, 2026
description: GitHub Mobile now supports fixing pull request comments with Copilot cloud agent.

title: Claude Platform and Code Updates - Mid-July 2026
description: Mid-conversation system messages became available on July 15, 2026. The claude-code repository shows version 2.1.212 with the /fork command for copying conversations into background sessions, auto-mode reset functionality, and various bug fixes. Weekly digest from July 13-17 includes Artifacts calling MCP (Model Context Protocol).

title: Windsurf/Devin Desktop Changelog Updates - July 15, 2026
description: Windsurf was rebranded to Devin Desktop. Updates include hardened migration on Windows, improved file context handling, and various bug fixes. Devin Cloud sessions now auto-reconnect when network returns.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. The rebrand reflects where the product is headed: a command center for managing local and cloud agents.
RIP Windsurf - Users saying goodbye to the Windsurf brand after rebrand to Devin
Some users noting they've spent $150-200 in usage credits since Windsurf launched

title: Quote Text in Messages - July 15, 2026
description: You can now select text in a session from files, worklog, or Devin's messages. AI context now includes security findings.

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio - June Update - July 14, 2026
description: June 2026 update focused on visibility and trust with clearer view of GitHub Copilot usage, new trust layer for MCP.

title: Code Scanning AI Security Detections - July 14, 2026
description: Code scanning now shows AI security detections on pull requests.

title: Codex CLI Updates - July 2026
description: Bug fixes for bundled instructions in GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna. Restored 272,000-token context windows and refreshed bundled instructions.

title: Gemini CLI v0.50.0 Stable Release - July 8, 2026
description: Latest stable release v0.50.0. Note: Gemini CLI was shut down on June 18, 2026, and is being transitioned to Antigravity CLI.

title: Cursor Side Chats and Conversation Search - July 10, 2026
description: Released side chats that run alongside main chat, agent transcript search, and simplified project and repo pickers.

title: Agentic Autofix for Code Scanning - July 10, 2026
description: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts entered public preview.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna Available in Copilot - July 9, 2026
description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models are now available in GitHub Copilot.

community_feedback.quote: Copilot has improved immensely in 2026. It works about as well as Claude Code these days in my experience.
GPT 5.6 Pro apparently solved all the IMO 2026 problems... no human steering and on first attempt. The bar for impressive keeps rising rapidly though.

title: Ask Copilot for Repository Overview - July 9, 2026
description: New feature to ask Copilot for a repository overview.

title: GitHub Copilot App Available to All - July 7, 2026
description: The GitHub Copilot app became available to all users.

title: Kimi K2.7 Now Available - July 7, 2026
description: Kimi K2.7 is now available for Copilot Business and Enterprise.

title: Devin Desktop and CLI Updates - July 7, 2026
description: Added 'New session in space' to session menu, fixed diff viewing issues in autonomous mode, added /mcp slash command with live MCP server status panel, and sandbox feature.

title: Windsurf v1.42 and Chat Improvements - July 4, 2026
description: Codeium v1.42 with chat improvements, UI & visual enhancements, command improvements, and enterprise & technical updates.

title: Copilot Vision Generally Available - July 1, 2026
description: Copilot vision became generally available.

community_feedback.quote: 2021-2026, Goodbye, Copilot - discussing the end of an era and billing model changes
The GitHub Copilot Changes Just Got Worse - users discussing pricing increases and removed features

title: Kimi K2.7 Code Generally Available - July 1, 2026
description: Kimi K2.7 Code is generally available in GitHub Copilot.

title: Browser Tools Generally Available - July 1, 2026
description: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are generally available.
